groups.title: Wide-belt deburring machines · value line
groups.lead: Wide-belt deburring and finishing machines from 12″ to 51.2″ wide, with one to three sanding heads — NovoTech value line, built in China.

intro_add: For the shop that starts deburring by machine, the NovoTech value-line MGM-300 (12″) and BFM-2560 (24″, with a wet dust collector) are wide-belt machines for laser-cut and punched parts, and the R series dry sanders take one to three sanding heads over 24.8″ or 51.2″.
